details.detail: Door-3 self-service bar (m05, m06, q11, m17) vs samchui_11. The flanking ash lavs, dark back wall with blind, landscape monitor, fridge with clear bottles and blue labels, and the ash sliding doors with round pulls all match. The canopy now reads as a dark soffit with a light strip, not a plank. The only thing still unverified is that the whole group is 1.05 m deep (see issues).

Door-2 welcome galley (m03, m16) vs lalf_134 and sp_09. It has ovens with windows on the left, the landscape monitor, the brewer in an open bay, the fridge on the right, ash lower doors, aluminium nosing and a dark soffit with downlights. lalf_134 has a deeper black counter recess and a bright aluminium frame around the whole opening; the model's frame is thinner and grey.

Door-2 aft monuments (m04, m13, m16, m18). The 7K galley has a white upper and ash lower, the portrait boarding monitor is on the charcoal end panel (matches sp_09) and the soffit spans the whole cross-aisle. The 7K galley ovens and brewer still read too clean and white next to sp_09's grey-beige inserts.

F front wall, flight-deck door and door 1 (q01, m01, m02). The ink-cloud walls now carry the print: m02 has a 10-90 % luminance spread of 23 %, against 22.8 % measured on omaatF_2 (ground #c5c7c3 vs #c1bdb2). But the boarding view q01 is dominated by two 0.35 m curtain columns in each 0.80 m opening, leaving only about 0.09 m clear. The ebony closet faces are flat, with a 43 % spread against 130 % in tpa_IMG_0260's streaked grain.

Lavatory exteriors (m03, m05, m09, m11, m17). The J ash doors have a white seam and grab handle, and the PY/Y doors are white laminate with occupancy signs. They are consistent with OMAAT-32 and the bar render.

F/J bulkhead J face and J backs of the door monuments (m07, m13, m14, m15) vs tpg_70 and tpg_71. The cream wall, the wall boxes under the bins with blue tops, and the charcoal tied curtains (#5e5550 rendered) all match. The tied bundle still stands about 0.2 m into a 0.52 m aisle, while in tpg_71 it hugs the panel edge.

J/PY bulkhead PY face (m08, q13) vs alv_IMG_7207 and 7209. The flat charcoal-framed monitors (2 + 4 at 1.5 m), the grey floor pouches, the bassinet sticker and the open-top outboard panels are right. The curtain is wrong in colour and in bulk. It renders #404766 slate-navy, while both in-service photos show warm near-black #292521 / #323030 (B-R -8 vs +38). It also fills about 0.35 of the 0.50 m aisle.

Door-4 group (m09, m10, q13). The layout follows the map: the wheelchair lav on the left, the centre galley behind row 27 with two grey boxes, the galley on the right and the centre galley aft. The slate PY aft curtains match py_37302 in hue family (rendered #3f4665 vs #424455, slightly too blue). They leave only 0.22 m clear in the left aisle and read as solid posts.

Rear, door 5 (m11, m12, q19). The fore-aft galleys, the outboard lavs, the centre closet and lav, and the aft-wall stowage (2x3 doors, deck, waste flap) are now present, and the work aisle no longer ends in a blank wall. The light-grey rear curtain reads as a 0.35 m structural pillar (m11). q19 does not show the galley at all: it shows the plain white back of the closet/lav from row 41/42, so the rear galley has only m12 as evidence.

Standard galley inserts (m01, m09, m12). The upper doors are inset with labels and paddles, the latches are small dark-red turn buttons, and the oven windows and brewer are present. In sp_09 and lalf_133 the real inserts are warm grey-beige (#b5aea4-ish) with blue status LEDs. The model's inserts are cool mid-grey with a brushed look, and every oven window is a flat beige rectangle.

Curtains overall. The F/J and J charcoal and the F-front taupe are about right in tone, and the ceiling tracks are present. But every untied 'panel' curtain is an elliptical cylinder 0.30-0.35 m across and 0.16-0.19 m deep, with shallow +/-16 % pleats and a flat top, and it stands in the aisle. Clear aisle widths (from the layout dump): F front 0.09 m, J/PY 0.15 m, door-4 0.22 m, rear 0.35 m. The J/PY colour is wrong (navy instead of warm black).

Jump seats. There are now 8: 1L, 1R, 2L, 2R, 3L and 3R on the lav walls (m17 and m18 read well: grey pad, harness, pedestal), plus two at door 5. Doors 4L and 4R still have none, so a Type A exit has no attendant station in the model.

issues.detail: F front openings almost closed by curtains (q01, m02)
issues.problem: Line 836 places two untied panels per opening at xg = a+0.18 and b-0.18. _curtainPanel is 0.10*1.5*1.16 = 0.174 m half-width, so each spans about 0.35 m. The 0.80 m openings (-1.68..-0.88 and 0.82..1.62) keep only about 0.09 m clear. q01, the boarding view at L1, is two dark closet walls and two taupe columns with a slit between them.
issues.evidence: q01_door1.png: curtain columns fill x 390-630 of 930 and the gap is about 30 px. ffF_cabin-overview-from-aisle shows two slim curtains framing a walkable opening of about 0.5 m.
issues.fix: In monoLayoutQA line 836, keep two curtains per opening but make them slim. Add a 'slim' option to addCurtain that uses a new _curtainSlim = curtainLoft([[0.02,0.75,0.55],[1.0,0.72,0.55],[CURTAIN_H-0.01,0.8,0.55]]), giving about 0.16 m wide and 0.07 m deep. Set xg = a+0.07 and b-0.07 so each bundle half-overlaps the closet end. Clear width becomes about 0.55 m.

issues.detail: Untied panel curtains block every aisle and read as posts (m08, m09, m10, m11, q13)
issues.problem: _curtainPanel is a closed elliptical tube (s 1.45-1.55, d 1.2-1.3): 0.30-0.35 m across the aisle, 0.16-0.19 m deep, with sin(11a) pleats of only 16 % and a flat lit top. Clear aisles: J/PY 0.15 m (xg = edge + 0.18 at line 711), door-4 0.22 m (xg -1.23 / 1.25 at lines 869-870), rear 0.35 m (lines 880-881). The real stacked-open curtains in alv_IMG_7209 hang at the panel edge with deep dark creases.
issues.evidence: m08 has a navy column filling most of the left aisle. m09 and m10 have navy posts with a smooth face. m11 has a light-grey 'pillar'.
issues.fix: (1) curtainLoft: raise the pleat to r = 1 + 0.35*sin(a*7), flatten the z half-depth from 0.065 to 0.04, and darken the vertex colour in the folds (c *= 0.75 + 0.25*max(0, sin(a*7))). (2) Panel scale to s 0.8-0.9, about 0.18 m across. (3) Put xg at the panel edge +/-0.06: line 711 use a.x1 + 0.06 / b.x0 - 0.06; door-4 xg -1.56 / 1.56 against the outboard lav/galley, or keep the centre side at -1.11 / 1.13; rear xg -1.06 / 1.06. That gives 0.35-0.45 m clear in each aisle.

issues.detail: J/PY curtain colour is navy, in-service it is warm near-black
issues.problem: Line 711 passes MONMAT.curtainY '#474b5e' for the J/PY gaps, and it renders #404766 (B-R +38). Both 2026 in-service photos of this bulkhead show a warm dark brown-charcoal. The navy/slate tone is only verified for the PY aft (door-4) curtains in py_37302.
issues.evidence: alv_IMG_7209 curtain median #292521, alv_IMG_7207 left edge #323030 (B-R -8 and -2). The wall in the same photos is #e2e6ed / #d3d2cd.
issues.fix: At line 711 use a new MONMAT.curtainJPY { c: '#3d3733', r: 0.95, l: LAYER.fabric } for the J/PY bulkhead (non-F branch). Keep curtainY for the explicit door-4 'Y' curtains, and reduce it slightly toward py_37302: '#484a58'.

issues.detail: Door arming arc is a third of the real size
issues.problem: The door-lining loop draws the red arc as a 0.008 m tube of radius 0.10 m (0.2 m across) at 1.15 m, with a vertical rod handle at c+0.26. In the in-service photos the arc is a painted red band about 0.55-0.6 m across and about 0.3 m tall, with an arrowhead and 'OPEN' at its aft end. A horizontal grey lever handle (about 0.2 x 0.06 m) sits in the arc centre at about 1.1 m, and a horizontal assist bar with a red flag runs across the top of the slide bustle at about 0.85 m.
issues.evidence: lalf_133: door about 230 px = 1.07 m, arc x 112-248 px = about 0.63 m, centre about 1.16 m. sp_09: arc about 0.48 m wide against the attendant. m17 and m18: the arc is a small red horseshoe.
issues.fix: Change the arc loop to 1.15 + 0.15*sin(t) in v and c + 0.28*cos(t) in z, drawn as a 0.025 m-wide flat band (gQuad strips or a flat gTube radius 0.012) with a 0.06 m arrowhead triangle at t = 0. Replace the vertical rod handle with a gRBox(0.06, 0.07, 0.22) lever at at(1.08, 0.04), centred on c. Add a horizontal assist bar gTube from c-0.3 to c+0.3 at v 0.86, inset 0.12, with a 0.05 x 0.06 MAT.handleRed flag.

issues.detail: No attendant seats at doors 4L and 4R
issues.problem: layout.jumps (line 883) lists 1L, 1R, 2L, 2R, 3L, 3R and 5L, 5R. At door 4 the left lav (z 42.90-43.70) and the right galley have faces toward the door, and there are no seats. Every floor-level Type A exit needs an adjacent attendant seat. Row 30 is drawn red on the ANA map, which suggests crew-adjacent restrictions.
issues.evidence: Layout dump: jumps has no entry with z 43.7 or 44.9. m09 and m10 show no jump seat.
issues.fix: Add [-2.20, dz[3][0], 1] on the wheelchair-lav wall outboard of its door (or narrow the lav door as done at door 3), and [2.20, dz[3][1], -1] on the aft face of the door-4 centre/right monument. Or mark them [A] and add them to questions for the user.

issues.detail: Door-3 monument depth still 1.05 m against the map
issues.problem: MONO_LAYOUT.d3 = 1.05 is unchanged since round 1. On the ANA map the row 16 to row 17 span is 218 px, against 183 px for rows 17 to 20. Scaling by rows 17-20 (4.62 m in the model) gives about 5.5 m for the door-3 zone, against 3.33 m modelled. The lav boxes are about 80 px, or about 2.0 m.
issues.evidence: ana_seatmap_73E.png, middle strip: row 16 y 523, door arrow 598, lav box 618-698, row 17 741, row 20 923 (display px).
issues.fix: User decision (question 6 of round 2 is still open). If the map wins, set MONO_LAYOUT.d3 = 1.5 and move rows 17-27 aft 0.45 m.

issues.detail: F ebony closet faces lack the streaked grain
issues.problem: darkWood #38302e renders flat: q01 wall #413838 with a 43 % luminance spread. tpa_IMG_0260 has strong horizontal reddish-purple streaks with a 130 % spread.
issues.fix: Raise the wood layer contrast for darkWood only, via a per-material l param if available, or make a 'darkWood' variant in LAYER_PARAMS (03_tex.js, a shared one-line edit) with contrast about 2.5x and a streak scale of about 0.4 m along x.

issues.detail: Galley inserts too cool and uniform
issues.problem: The oven, chiller and cart faces are cool brushed grey, and every oven window is the same flat beige quad. In sp_09 and lalf_133 the inserts are warm light grey-beige with small blue LED status windows.
issues.evidence: sp_09 left galley; lalf_134 ovens; m01 and m12.
issues.fix: Shift the insert material toward '#b3aca2' and set the oven window to a darker smoked '#3a3a38' with a 0.04 m blue emissive LED strip above each insert.

issues.detail: QA view q19 misses the rear galley
issues.problem: q19 (walk(0, 1.62, 58.9, PI)) renders row 41/42 seats in front of the plain white back of the centre closet/lav (z 56.62), probably because walk() clamps into the econ walkable area. The door-5 galleys are only evidenced by m12.
issues.fix: Not in 10_mono.js. Ask the integrator to place q19 at x 0, z 59.5 (inside the galley work aisle) with setView instead of walk. Meanwhile consider a thin ash-free literature/placard panel on the Y face of the closet/lav at z 56.62.

questionsForUser: Door-3 depth: the ANA map implies about 5.5 m from row 16 to row 17 (lavs about 2 m deep); the model has 3.33 m (lavs 1.05 m). Should the map win, moving rows 17-27 about 0.45-2 m aft?
Door 4: do you have a photo showing where the 4L/4R attendant seats are (on the wheelchair-lav wall, or aft of the door on the galley)? The model currently has none there.

J/PY curtains: the 2026 in-service photos (The Alviator) show warm near-black curtains, while ANA's official PY photo shows slate-navy at the PY aft end. Is it correct that the J/PY bulkhead uses the dark J curtains and only the PY/Y boundary is navy?
